QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] A Letter from Ereve
QuestInfo.0: #bThree Moon#k of the Magician Association wishes to speak to you.
QuestInfo.1: #bThree Moon#k of the Magician Association wishes to speak to you. A letter has arrived from #bEreve#k, and you should read it yourself. Go to the #bMagician Association#k and speak with #bThree Moon#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have been invited to the Maple Alliance by #bEmpress Cygnus#k. Everyone has high hopes for you in the coming battles.
